title: Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2025

qualification: Proficiency in Data Structures, Algorithms, and coding in C++, Java, or Python
description: Join Google for a 12-14 week summer internship working on distributed systems, machine learning models, and real-world software infrastructure.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the UK pursuing a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.
qualification: Bachelor's degree with exceptional academic achievements and demonstrated leadership potential
description: A premier international scholarship supporting outstanding applicants to pursue full-time postgraduate studies at Cambridge.

title: Associate Software Engineer
eligibility: Recent graduates or candidates graduating within the current academic year in STEM disciplines.
qualification: Strong foundation in C#, C++, Java, or Python, and familiarity with cloud architecture
description: Develop scalable cloud solutions, AI tools, and core software products while collaborating with global development teams at Microsoft.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Entry-level or early career professionals eligible to work remotely worldwide.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to students and self-learners worldwide; no prior programming experience required.
qualification: Basic computer literacy and enthusiasm for problem-solving
description: Harvard University's flagship introductory computer science course teaching algorithmic thinking, C, Python, SQL, HTML, and JavaScript.

title: Imagine Cup Global Student Competition
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university worldwide.

description: A premier global competition empowering student developers to build innovative tech solutions addressing critical global challenges.
